target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Private marina with direct Lake Erie access located near Geneva On The Lake. Offers seasonal dock openings and markets them actively - indicating demand exceeds supply. Perfect candidate for a waitlist system to manage seasonal slip turnover and prospective member inquiries. Private club model with limited dock space creates natural scarcity requiring waitlist management.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Large facility with 250 boat slips and 32 campground sites on Ashtabula River - 20-minute cruise to Lake Erie. Full amenities: pool/spas, pump-out station, modern restrooms/showers. Markets itself as 'Lake Erie's Hottest Marina and Campground'. Already uses Dockwa for online reservations showing technology adoption. Waitlist system would complement existing booking infrastructure for high-demand seasonal spots.
